create_mole_layer: create a MOLE mixture of experts linear layer with multiple expert weights and mixing coefficients
create_moledgl_layer: create a MOLEDGL layer that uses fairchem_cpp segment_mm for efficient expert-weighted matrix multiplication
init_linear_experts: initialize random expert weights and optional bias for a mixture of experts linear layer
compute_interval_intersection: compute the intersection of two numeric intervals and return the overlapping range or None
merge_mole_to_linear: merge a MOLE mixture of experts layer into a single standard PyTorch Linear layer using expert mixing coefficients
